items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: And then there was John Lindsay and Bud Scott and James Arnold, who is here now.

ctx.x: Yeah, we had a guitar and banjo and Buddy Christian. He could play the guitar too. And then there was John Lindsay and Bud Scott and James Arnold, who is here now. We call him banjo because he used to play the banjos. Oh, yeah. I don't remember that name. Bud Scott?
No, Bud Scott I remember. The other James... Arnold. Arnold.
